text:
Dawn in blushes

your face resembles:

do not open your eyes,

for night is falling!


Close —if anger

the light offers you—

the red lips,

for day is breaking!


Shadow in profusion,

light: you are truly mine!

Dark eyes:


very good night!

Ripe lips:

very good day!

translation.title: Dawn in Blushes...
translation.editorial_note: This first-line version keeps the same paired good night and good day address.
